### How each waste company performs (fictional companies)
**On time** and **tickets shared**: higher is better. **Invoice errors**: lower is better. Use these as facts for contract talks, not as blame —
some differences come from sensors or missing data.

panels.title: On time — share of lifts that came as planned

targets.rawSql: SELECT replace(operator_name, ' (fictional)', '') AS "Waste company", round((100 * avg(on_time_rate))::numeric) AS "%" FROM cp_scorecard WHERE operator_name IN ($operator) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Tickets shared — truck weight sent to the customer within 7 days

targets.rawSql: SELECT replace(operator_name, ' (fictional)', '') AS "Waste company", round((100 * avg(weighbridge_shared_7d_rate))::numeric) AS "%" FROM cp_scorecard WHERE operator_name IN ($operator) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Invoice errors — lines that differ from the contract

targets.rawSql: SELECT replace(operator_name, ' (fictional)', '') AS "Waste company", round((100 * avg(discrepant_line_rate))::numeric, 1) AS "%" FROM cp_scorecard WHERE operator_name IN ($operator) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT operator_name AS "Waste company", region_code AS "Region", round((100 * avg(on_time_rate))::numeric) AS "On time %", round((100 * avg(missed_visit_rate))::numeric, 1) AS "Missed visits %", round((100 * avg(weighbridge_shared_7d_rate))::numeric) AS "Tickets shared %", round(avg(billing_overcharge_pct)::numeric, 1) AS "Overcharged %", round((100 * avg(discrepant_line_rate))::numeric, 1) AS "Invoice errors %", round(avg(weight_bias_pct) FILTER (WHERE weight_bias_status = 'MEASURED')::numeric, 1) AS "Weight vs our scale % (measured)", round((100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE weight_bias_status = 'MEASURED') / count(*))::numeric) AS "Months with weight evidence %" FROM cp_scorecard WHERE operator_name IN ($operator) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
